definition: Synthetic media, typically video or audio, generated or manipulated using AI to convincingly depict a real person saying or doing something they did not actually say or do.
details: Deepfakes raise significant concerns around misinformation, fraud, and consent, and have motivated research into both detection techniques and provenance/watermarking approaches for authenticating genuine media.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. In plain words: Synthetic media, typically video or audio, generated or manipulated using AI to convincingly depict a real person saying or doing something they did not actually say or do. Here is how it actually plays out: Deepfakes raise significant concerns around misinformation, fraud, and consent, and have motivated research into both detection techniques and provenance/watermarking approaches for authenticating genuine media. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. That deliberate caution is Deepfake.
